title: Binance hires Mandiant, SlowMist and Verichains for independent security reviews after October 29 attack
date_note: Day Binance announced the engagement, per Verichains and Blockonomi.
geo_basis: no place stated in the sources
summary: Binance announced on 23 November that it engaged Mandiant, SlowMist and Verichains for independent reviews of its security, Verichains says. Blockonomi reports the engagement came nearly four weeks after the 29 October attack and quotes Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su saying the firms will review its systems and tell it where it can be stronger.
plain: After its October 29 attack, Binance has hired three outside security firms to review its defences, according to Verichains and Blockonomi.
exec: Binance has brought in three outside firms to review its security after its October 29 attack, according to Verichains and Blockonomi.

sources.name: Verichains: Binance Engages Verichains for Independent Security Reviews

validation.note: Verichains (a named firm in the engagement) and Blockonomi each state that Binance hired the firms; Binance's own statement was not read.

review.note: stronger than source/added fact: exec root-cause sentence not in summary removed; summary reworded to match Blockonomi
